exact_reverse_design: Reverse the original puzzle tuple while retaining puzzle IDs and mechanism/recipe/clue/item bindings. Assign new rooms using the original per-room puzzle counts, with rooms in original forward order.

Replace each puzzle prerequisites with the immediately previous puzzle in that new order; first puzzle is the original final item puzzle, free of prerequisites. Puzzle object locked_by follows the same preceding puzzle.

Keep the actual reusable item in room ordinal0, unlocked. Move basic code_source to its actual owning code puzzle room; move extra_code/devices fragments to their actual owning puzzle room. Keep base device source and relation in room ordinal0.
Make relation locked_by exactly the first item puzzle. It never gates that item or its required key, so it is a discovery change even for one room without creating the proposed immediate self-lock.

For reverse only, pack original-relative-order nonpuzzle objects followed by puzzle objects in the new chain order; assign unique local slots0..count-1 per room. Forward is returned unchanged, preserving all original slots/IDs/locks.
Do not move objects by hardcoded obj_key or puzzle_1 numbers. Resolve roles/actual references and room ordinal from the selected immutable Blueprint.
static_reachability_argument: New chain room indices are nondecreasing; each prerequisite is earlier, each required item/clue is in the current or an earlier room, and relation unlock comes from the first free item puzzle using the unlocked first-room key. Thus the metadata model shows no future-room/self-lock obstruction. This is not a new engine-action witness or proof: circuit solving, typed values,25k/5s resource bounds and all admission rules must still be checked by the unchanged compiler.
single_room_difference: Code and item change actual prerequisite direction/order; relation changes from initially visible to first-item-gated. Reverse packing also places the first item puzzle where the first code puzzle previously stood. This is more than ID/name/parameter renaming.
multiroom_difference: Basic code material moves from first room to the code puzzle final room, extras move with new puzzle ownership, relation discovery is gated. Cross-room proof must cite shared relation/base device material to later puzzles; the reverse item-first key is same-room and cannot be claimed as its cross-room dependency.
